title: 1525. Number of Good Ways to Split a String

examples.explanation: There are 5 ways to split "aacaba" and 2 of them are good. ("a", "acaba") Left string and right string contains 1 and 3 different letters respectively. ("aa", "caba") Left string and right string contains 1 and 3 different letters respectively. ("aac", "aba") Left string and right string contains 2 and 2 different letters respectively (good split). ("aaca", "ba") Left string and right string contains 2 and 2 different letters respectively (good split). ("aacab", "a") Left string and right string contains 3 and 1 different letters respectively.
